title: TAKING A TAXI
conversation: Ian gets in a taxi. He's in a big rush because he has an interview in ten minutes. Unfortunately, he gets stuck in traffic. Ali: Where are you headed? Ian: 411 Wall Street. Ali: Hop in! Ian: I've got a meeting in 10 minutes. Can you step on it? Ali: This is the fastest I can go. If I go any faster, I'm going to get pulled over. Ian: Don't you know some back roads we can take? Ali: No, this is the best way to go. Oops! That was a close call. That bus almost hit us! Ian: I've got an interview at 10. Ali: I hate to break it to you, but there's bumper-to-bumper traffic up ahead. Ian: Yes, I see that traffic is heavy. What's going on? Ali: It looks like there was a fender bender. Now there's rubber necking. Ian: What rotten luck! Ali: We're only five blocks away. It'll be quicker if I let you out here and you run the rest of the way. Ian: Okay. Here's 10 bucks. Keep the change.

idioms.meaning_en: To be going in a particular direction or to a particular destination.
idioms.meaning_vi: Đang đi về hướng nào, đến địa điểm nào.

idioms.meaning_en: An informal invitation to get into a vehicle.
idioms.meaning_vi: Lời mời thân mật để lên xe (vào xe).

idioms.meaning_en: To go faster, especially when driving a vehicle.
idioms.meaning_vi: Tăng tốc, lái xe nhanh hơn.
idioms.example: We're late, you need to step on it!

idioms.meaning_en: To be stopped by the police while driving.
idioms.meaning_vi: Bị cảnh sát giao thông dừng xe kiểm tra.
idioms.example: I hope I don't get pulled over for speeding.
idioms.context: If I go any faster, I'm going to get pulled over.

idioms.meaning_en: A minor road, often less traveled and scenic, usually connecting rural areas or serving as an alternative to main roads.
idioms.meaning_vi: Đường nhỏ, đường nông thôn, đường tắt, thường ít người qua lại hoặc là con đường thay thế cho đường chính.
idioms.example: We took the back road to avoid the highway traffic.
idioms.context: Don't you know some back roads we can take?

idioms.meaning_en: A narrow escape from danger or disaster; a situation where something bad almost happened.
idioms.meaning_vi: Tình huống suýt gặp nguy hiểm hoặc tai nạn; thoát hiểm trong gang tấc.
idioms.example: That near collision was a real close call.

idioms.meaning_en: To tell someone bad news, usually gently or carefully.
idioms.meaning_vi: Báo tin xấu cho ai đó, thường là một cách nhẹ nhàng hoặc cẩn thận.
idioms.example: I don't know how to break it to him that he didn't get the job.
idioms.context: I hate to break it to you, but there's bumper-to-bumper traffic up ahead.

idioms.meaning_en: Traffic that is so heavy that vehicles are very close together and moving very slowly or not at all.
idioms.meaning_vi: Tình trạng giao thông ùn tắc nghiêm trọng, xe cộ nối đuôi nhau di chuyển rất chậm hoặc không di chuyển được.
idioms.example: There was bumper-to-bumper traffic on the highway during rush hour.

idioms.meaning_en: A large number of vehicles on the road, causing slow movement.
idioms.meaning_vi: Lượng xe cộ đông đúc trên đường, gây cản trở di chuyển.
idioms.example: We encountered heavy traffic on our way to the beach.
idioms.context: Yes, I see that traffic is heavy. What's going on?

idioms.meaning_en: A minor car accident causing only slight damage.
idioms.meaning_vi: Một vụ va chạm xe ô tô nhỏ, chỉ gây hư hại nhẹ.
idioms.example: Luckily, it was just a minor fender bender, and no one was hurt.
idioms.context: It looks like there was a fender bender.

idioms.meaning_en: To slow down or turn one's head to stare at something (especially an accident or something unusual), often impeding traffic.
idioms.meaning_vi: Chậm lại hoặc ngoái đầu nhìn chằm chằm vào cái gì đó (đặc biệt là tai nạn hoặc điều bất thường), thường làm cản trở giao thông.
idioms.example: People started to rubberneck as they passed the accident scene.

idioms.meaning_en: Very bad fortune or unfortunate circumstances.
idioms.example: It was just rotten luck that our flight was canceled.

idioms.meaning_en: To tell someone, often a service person like a taxi driver, to retain the remaining money after a payment.
idioms.meaning_vi: Giữ lại tiền thừa (thường dùng khi trả tiền cho người làm dịch vụ như tài xế taxi, phục vụ).
idioms.example: “The total is $8.50,” said the cashier. “Here's $10, keep the change.”
